fields.query: SELECT designation, ra, dec, w3mpro, w3snr, w3rchi2, w4mpro, w4snr, w4rchi2 FROM allwise_p3as_psd WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 150.0000, 2.2000, 1.0)) = 1 AND ext_flg = 0 AND cc_flags = '0000' AND nb = 1 AND na = 0 AND w3sat = 0 AND w4sat = 0 AND w3snr >= 20 AND w4snr >= 10 AND w3rchi2 < 2 AND w4rchi2 < 2 AND w3mpro - w4mpro BETWEEN -0.2 AND 0.3
